claims.claim: A dedicated hidden-state confidence estimator can substantially outperform verbalized confidence on math and QA.
claims.stance_target: R1 candidates L1-L4/F occupancy; L2 general-domain analogue; not code
claims.scope_conditions: non-code; NOT a code occupant of L2 on code, but a close general-domain occupant of the probe/estimator-beats-verbal claim for reasoning/QA with trained verbalization baselines.
claims.quoted_support: Our empirical study shows that a dedicated confidence estimator can substantially outperform verbalized confidence, indicating that LLMs' internal representations contain richer confidence signals.

claims.claim: The estimator is a linear head on the last non-padding token hidden state trained with squared error to correctness; verbalized RL reward adds a Brier-style term.
claims.stance_target: R1 candidates L1-L4/F occupancy; L2 general-domain analogue; not code

claims.quoted_support: by applying a linear head to the hidden state of the last non-padding token
